entities.summary: John of La Verna, an Italian Franciscan friar, spent his life in asceticism and preaching on the mountain of La Verna in Umbria, Italy, from 1300 to 1322. His time on the mountain led to a deeper understanding of spirituality and the importance of humility, which he shared with his followers and the wider Franciscan Order. The writings and teachings of John of La Verna had a lasting impact on the spirituality of the Franciscans, shaping their approach to prayer, poverty, and charity. His legacy can be seen in the continued emphasis on contemplation and simplicity in Franciscan life, as well as in the numerous monasteries and churches he helped establish during his lifetime.
